Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Title: Water Balloon Challenge
Content:
:ibox:• The mass and the speed of a water balloon affects its kinetic energy.

• The maximum mass for the water balloons is `text(0.92 kilograms)`.

• Water balloons with the most kinetic energy will have the biggest splash radius on impact.

The students want to make sure they are creating the largest splash radius possible. They lean a large piece of cardboard against a wall to act as a target. They catapult a `text(0.46-kg)` water balloon at the target at a speed of `text(8 m/s)` and mark the splash radius with a marker. Next, they catapult a `text(0.92-kg)` water balloon at the target at a speed of `text(8 m/s)` and mark its splash radius with a marker.
They confirm that the water balloon with the larger mass has a much larger splash radius than the water balloon with the smaller mass.
